purpose: Frozen reference signals. Bytes are the oracle, not the generator: a signal regenerated from a seed changes when the generator changes, which is how the G.711 vectors came to be frozen. `truth` is a property of each signal and never changes. `annotator_now` records what this revision of the code produces, so a regression is visible as a difference rather than becoming the new baseline.
conformance: An independent implementation should reproduce `truth.speech_end_sample` on the stimulus to within a stated tolerance, and should publish its onset figures for the three responses so its detector can be compared with ours. This is what the IETF draft needs in order to specify a conformance test rather than an algorithm.
